data.title: Mercedes-Benz Thailand announces H1 2026 sales, highlighting 130% BEV growth
data.description: Mercedes-Benz (Thailand) Limited announced its business performance for the first half of2026, highlighting remarkable growth in thebatteryelectric vehicle (BEV) segment with an increase of more than130%, driven by the strong success of the all-new electric CLA.Reinforcing its positioning as a Mobility Solutions Provider, the company also unveiled a major rebranding of its financial products and after-sales services under the new "FLEX Mobility Campaign",guided by the concept "Flex to fit you".The campaign is designed to deliver a more flexible Mercedes-Benz ownership experience through the introduction of theStarChoicepackage, allowing customers topersonalizetheir ownership journey with a choice of three value-added services:StarProtectionfirst-class insurance, theStarCareperiodicmaintenance program, and theStarGuaranteeextended warranty program. Customers may choose individual options or a comprehensive package covering all three services for only THB6,000per month, offering savings of up to THB400,000*compared topurchasingeach package separately.Thispackageistailoredto meet the diverse needs of retail customers,corporate clients, and fleet operators,andthe FLEX Mobility Campaign will officiallycommenceon1August2026.
